pattern.description: RFIC bus command: optionally read status, write command word to 0x804, then read 0x14 to fence/flush the posted RF bus write.
pattern.template_c: void rf_bus_cmd(uint32_t cmd) { (void)*((volatile uint32_t *)0x804); *((volatile uint32_t *)0x804) = cmd; (void)*((volatile uint32_t *)0x14); }
